Heard Mr. Imran Mabood Khan, the learned counsel for applicant and the learned A.G.A. for State.
Counter affidavit filed by learned A.G.A. in Court today is taken on record.

This application under section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed challenging the summoning order dated 27.8.2021, passed by Chief Judicial Magistrate, Farrukhabad in Criminal Case No. 4027 of 2021 (State Vs. Kaushal Yadav and Others) under Sections 447, 420, 406, 468 IPC, Police Station- Farrukhabad Kotwali, District Fatehgarh arising out of Case Crime No. 740 of 2020, under Sections 447, 420, 406, 468 IPC, Police Station- Farrukhabad Kotwali, District Fatehgarh, now pending in the Court of Chief Judicial Magistrate, Farrukhabad.

sentences.text: Learned counsel for applicants submits that applicant-1 is Mutawali of waqf registered as Waqf No. I 189.
Applicants- 2 to 8 are tenants of the waqf property.
The tenancy originated on account of temporary lease deed executed by Mutawali of the Waqf i.e. applicant-1, in favour of the applicants-2 to 8.

On the aforesaid premise, he submits that since applicant-1 is Mutawali of the trust he has right to execute lease deed in favour of applicants-2 to 8 in whose favour the waqf property is to be given on rent.
Thus, no illegality has been committed by applicant-1.
As such no offence under sections 441 and 406 is made out against applicants as there was no entrustment in favour of applicant.

Investigating Officer while submitting the charge sheet has completely ignored the aforesaid aspect of the matter and therefore erroneously charge sheeted the applicants under sections 441 and 406 IPC.
It is further contended that since no document has been forged by applicants, no offence under section 468 IPC is made out against applicant.
The power to administer a waqf is vested in the waqf Board which appoints the Muttawali.
Admittedly, no proceedings have been initiated by the waqf Board against the Muttawali i.e. applicant-1 regarding the lease deed executed by him in favour of applicants-2 to 8.
It was the Waqf Board which could have suffered lose on account of alleged cheating committed by the applicants.
But no proceedings have been initiated by the Waqf Board.
There is nothing on record to show that there was an intention on the part of applicants to cheat the Waqf Board right from inception.
As such no offence under section 420 IPC is made out against applicants either.

It is lastly submitted that the order dated 20.8.2020, passed by District Magistrate is patently illegal inasmuch as concerned District Magistrate has no power to pas any order in respect of waqf property.
As such, the present criminal proceedings are wholly malicious and an abuse of the process of the Court.
Since no offence as complained of is made out against applicants therefore same is liable to be quashed by this Court.
Per contra, the learned A.G.A. has opposed the present application.
Learned A.G.A. submits that charge sheet submitted by Investigating Officer has not been challenged in present application.
In the absence of any challenge to the charge sheet, submissions urged by learned counsel for applicant are misconceived.

It is next contended by learned A.G.A. that in view of the submissions urged by learned counsel for applicant that no offence is made out as per material on record, remedy lies to applicants to approach Court below under section 239 Cr.P.C. and seek discharge, as Court below will have the advantage of entire material before it.

Learned A.G.A. also submits that present proceedings have been initiated on account of order dated 10.8.2020, passed by District Magistrate,
Farukhabad which has not been challenged till date.
Learned A.G.A. also submits that vide order dated 20.8.2020, District Magistrate has declared the applicants to be land mafia and further directed that F.I.R. be lodged.
Temporary lease deeds whereby tenancy was created in favour of applicants- 2 to 8 was executed by applicant-1 but for a period of 11 months.
However, the right to raise constructions was also granted which is manifestly illegal.
He, therefore contends that no jurisdictional error has been committed by Court below in passing the impugned order.

Having heard Mr. Imran Mabood Khan, the learned counsel for applicant, the learned A.G.A. for State and upon perusal of record this Court finds that no useful purpose shall be served by keeping this application pending.
Accordingly, this application is disposed of finally with liberty to applicants to appear before Court below and file a discharge application in terms of section 239 Cr.P.C. within a period of two weeks Nahid Husain And 7 Others vs State Of U.P. And Another on 20 January, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/25192304/
2 from today along with a certified copy of this order.

sentences.text:
In case, such a discharge application is filed,
within the prescribed period, Court below shall decide the same by a reasoned speaking order within a period of two months thereafter.
It goes without saying that Court below shall proceed against the applicants only after the disposal of discharge application.
